remarks: Set within the Kingsley Court community, this completely remodeled second-floor condo offers a bright, comfortable living space with thoughtful updates throughout. Hardwood floors and abundant natural light create an inviting atmosphere, while crown molding and fresh paint add a polished finish. The updated kitchen features modern appliances and a clean, functional layout, complemented by a remodeled bathroom. The spacious bedroom includes two generously sized closets, providing ample storage. Residents enjoy the ease of included services such as snow removal, landscaping, common area maintenance, hot water, and one assigned parking space, along with access to a community room at the center of the complex. Ideally located near I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, the property offers quick access to Norwalk Hospital, The SoNo Collection, the Maritime Aquarium, and a wide array of local restaurants and shops. No pets. Excellent credit, references, and verifiable income required. Your new home awaits.
